method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 4 of 4 breaks heard

lines.english: O my Jesus, forgive us our sins,
save us from the fires of hell,

lines.latin: perduc in cælum omnes ánimas, præsértim illas quæ máxime índigent misericórdiæ tuæ.
lines.english: and lead all souls to heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

lines.latin: Ora pro nobis qui confúgimus ad te.
lines.english: pray for us who have recourse to thee.
